mechanism_narrative: Workplace mobility rebounded sharply from -21.0 to -15.1 percent in the latest week, indicating renewed commuting activity that will lift weekday retail and recreation footfall over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -21.0 to -15.1 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is not higher than its last-28-day mean despite WORKPLACES staying above -16 for the following two weeks, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: As PARKS mobility drops below -38 percent amid Melbourne's winter cold snap, outdoor recreational trips are substituted for indoor retail and recreation visits, pushing RETAIL_REC upward over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls below -38.0 percent
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell to -38.6 at t-0w, its lowest value in the snapshot
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next two weeks following a PARKS reading below -38.0, or if PARKS rebounds above -35 without RETAIL_REC falling, the substitution mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Transit station mobility has remained persistently suppressed near -40 percent across all four weeks, signaling ongoing public caution or policy guidance against crowded transit use, which continues to limit retail and recreation access and keeps RETAIL_REC flat to lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT ranged between -39.3 and -40.3 across all four weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean rises above its last-28-day mean while TRANSIT remains below -38, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Residential mobility has stayed elevated near 6 percent above baseline for four consecutive weeks, reflecting a persistent stay-at-home behavioral pattern that will continue to cap retail and recreation outings over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed between 5.6 and 6.6 across all four weeks
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean increases despite RESIDENTIAL remaining above 6.0 throughout the period, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising WORKPLACES mobility and upticking GROCERY_PHARM mobility indicates a broader consumer mobility recovery; when both series move upward together, the synergistic increase in errand-linked trips amplifies RETAIL_REC growth beyond what WORKPLACES alone would predict over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -21.0 to -15.1 while GROCERY_PHARM rose from 0.4 to 1.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC fails to rise more than a WORKPLACES-only model would predict when both WORKPLACES and GROCERY_PHARM rise concurrently, the interaction effect is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT mobility remains below -35 percent for four consecutive weeks amid winter COVID-19 caution advisories in Victoria, the sustained reduction in transit-enabled shopping trips will keep RETAIL_REC depressed over the following four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -35.0 for four consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT has stayed below -39 for all four observed weeks
regime_hint: winter COVID-19 caution regime without lockdown
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite TRANSIT staying below -35 for the entire period, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL mobility crosses above 7.0 percent, indicating a further shift toward home-based living, RETAIL_REC will decline over the subsequent two weeks as discretionary outings are curtailed.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL peaked at 6.6 in the snapshot, approaching the 7.0 threshold
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL exceeds 7.0 but RETAIL_REC does not fall over the following two weeks, the threshold hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Winter seasonal suppression of outdoor activity, reflected in deeply negative PARKS readings, coincides with marginally lower RETAIL_REC at t-0w; this seasonal drag will persist over the next week, keeping RETAIL_REC slightly below its recent four-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC fell to -15.0 at t-0w alongside PARKS falling to -38.6
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC rises in the next week despite PARKS remaining below -37, the seasonal drag hypothesis is rejected.
